name: GMR Airports Ltd.
business_summary: Private airport operator: Delhi (DIAL), Hyderabad (GHIAL), Goa Mopa, Bhogapuram (Visakhapatnam), Crete (Greece), Cebu, plus cargo, hospitality and land development. Revenue Rs16.0k cr TTM (+29%), EBITDA Rs6.1k cr (38%), but interest ~Rs3.8k cr and PAT only Rs788 cr TTM; Q2 FY27 PAT Rs65 cr (+86%) on revenue ~Rs4,095 cr (+11.6%). Traffic: H1 FY27 record 58.2m passengers but growth was flat Apr-Sep (+0.9% in Sept). Promoters 67.5%, FIIs 22.95%. Delhi Cargo Terminal 1 concession award letter received 2026-11-04.

cost_structure.input: airport operating costs (staff, utilities, concession/revenue-share fees to AAI)
cost of goods/services for retail and F&B

exposures.mechanism: Revenue Rs16.0k cr TTM: aero (regulated per-pax tariffs) ~45%, non-aero (retail, F&B, parking, real estate) ~40%, cargo/other ~15% (model estimate). +10% pax => revenue +~8% = +Rs1.28k cr at ~85% drop-through => EBITDA +Rs1.1k cr on Rs6.1k cr TTM = +18%; EV/MCap ~1.45 (net debt ~Rs 45k cr, model estimate); persistence 0.5 (aero true-up returns part of upside to airlines) => +13, trimmed to +9 as traffic has been flat (+0.9% in Sept) and valuations already discount a recovery. Traffic data: H1 FY27 58.2m record but Apr-Sep growth flat.

evidence.note: flat Apr-Sep traffic guided, H2 recovery; Bhogapuram opening advanced (as reported)

exposures.mechanism: Fuel at ~35-40% of airline costs => fares +4-5% per +10% Brent => ~-1.5% pax in 6 months (price elasticity ~-1.2 on leisure) => EBITDA -2.5% x1.45 x0.5 persistence... airlines also cut capacity. Pack -0.94 per +10% (t -1.8): agrees; central -1.5.

exposures.mechanism: Debt ~Rs 45k cr (est.), ~60% floating/MCLR-linked: +25bp = ~Rs70 cr/yr vs TTM PAT Rs788 cr (9%) and vs Q2 PAT Rs65 cr; interest coverage low (EBITDA 1,480 vs interest 993 in Q2). Equity value impact: ΔPAT 9% x0.4 persistence x (equity/PAT leverage 1.0) + discount effect => -3.

exposures.mechanism: Airport capex (Bhogapuram, Hyderabad, Delhi expansion ~Rs 40-50k cr over 5y) uses steel/aluminium; pack -1.65 (t -2.0) for aluminium is probably a high-beta/commodity-cycle artefact; fundamentals imply small effect: construction materials ~30% of capex => +10% aluminium (aluminium ~5% of materials) = +0.15% capex; keep -0.4 low confidence.

company_links.mechanism: IndiGo is the largest airline at Delhi and Hyderabad (~55-65% of domestic pax, estimate), so IndiGo capacity reductions or distress cut pax and non-aero spend. Mapping: IndiGo -10% equity (capacity cuts/ stress) => ~-0.5% GMR Airports.
